definition: A vehicle that is manufactured, assembled, or modified in quantities of 500 or less in any one year, and is not of a make and model previously certified for the New Zealand market.
The Low Volume Vehicle Technical Association. This is the organization appointed by the NZ Transport Agency to oversee the LVV certification system in New Zealand.
A person appointed by the LVVTA to inspect and certify modified and scratch-built vehicles.
A document that outlines the legal and technical requirements for LVV Certifiers.
A manual that provides information, advice, and recommendations for the construction of scratch-built low volume vehicles.
